Player exactly commands: Impersonate the Magister again. 
"I said not to let anyone in. I am not to be disturbed. Everything is fine in here." Station Kestrel Day281 ~20:51, V and Fenar concealed behind laboratory-side SOLID STONE corner before 20ft exposed passage to closed iron inner vault/armored guardian. KN-G6 existing corridor Guard stands outside LOCKED lab WEST door after hearing Fenar's prior east-vent grille clink (genuine Fenar Stealth3+5=8 vs passive12), has already called "Magister? Everything all right in there?" and rattled handle but has not seen V/Fenar or entered. V attempts a second MAGISTER VOICE impersonation, reusing ordinary deceptive voice mimicry that previously worked with V Deception+9, but prior success does not guarantee this new suspicious check. Predeclared Deception DC17 based on same guard and earlier voice impersonation, V Deception skill +9 owning CSV, no advantage or Past Life bonus (PastLife0/3). GENUINE Python secrets.randbelow(20)+1 d20 FACE7+9=16 vs DC17 FAIL by1. V audibly says the exact directed quote, no magical spell, action surge, features, items, psionic resource or coin expended. Guard recognizes similar Magister delivery and explicitly references old instruction, but is not satisfied after hearing noise near shutters. From OUTSIDE still-LOCKED west lab door he responds: "Yes, Magister. I remember your instructions. But I heard something at the shutters. And that sounded rather like someone else moving about in there. Sir, I'm responsible for securing this corridor. Open the door so I can make certain everything is in order." Guard shifts boots at door, suspicious and now requests inspection; NO automatic door breach, rescue, alarm, reinforcements, magister identification or combat has yet occurred. V/Fenar remain at solid covered north lab vault corridor corner; fixed Helmed Horror remains at closed iron vault door down exposed20ft passage, not alerted or engaged by this dialogue as no evidence it heard through layout or saw V. Bound gagged unconscious Magister KN-M1 still0/40 at lab table stable expected~22:17 wake if unchanged.
